items.text: On November 10, the eve of Armistice Day, Kate Smith sang Irving Berlin's God Bless America for the first time on her weekly radio show.
items.question: Who in your house listened to Kate Smith, and where was the radio when you first heard her sing God Bless America?
items.source_quote: November 10 – On the eve of Armistice Day, Kate Smith sings Irving Berlin's "God Bless America" for the first time on her weekly radio show.

items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 3 cents an ounce.
items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost three cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: A-Tisket, A-Tasket by the Chick Webb Orchestra, with Ella Fitzgerald singing, was listed among the popular records of 1938 in the United States.
items.question: Where were you living when Ella Fitzgerald's A-Tisket, A-Tasket was on the radio, and who did you dance or sing it with?
source_quote: The twenty popular records listed below

Chick Webb Orchestra (vocal Ella Fitzgerald) "A-Tisket, A-Tasket" Decca 1840 May 2, 1938 (1938-05-02) June 1938 (1938-06) US Billboard 1938 #1, US #1 for 10 weeks, 19 total weeks, Grammy Hall of Fame 1986, 250,000 sales

items.text: On June 22, heavyweight boxing champion Joe Louis knocked out Max Schmeling in the first round of their rematch at Yankee Stadium in New York City.
items.question: Where were you the night Joe Louis fought Max Schmeling, and whose radio did you listen to it on?
items.source_quote: June 22 – Heavyweight boxing champion Joe Louis knocks out Max Schmeling in the first round of their rematch at Yankee Stadium in New York City.

items.text: On October 30, Orson Welles's radio adaptation of The War of the Worlds was broadcast.
items.question: Where were you the night The War of the Worlds was on the radio, and who in your house heard it?
items.source_quote: October 30 – Orson Welles's radio adaptation of The War of the Worlds (with script by Howard Koch) is broadcast, causing panic in various parts of the United States.
